name: Missed milestone client reply
summary: When a client challenges a delay, a deliverable or an earlier commitment, the account director gets a draft reply and an internal action note that keep confirmed facts apart from proposed recovery steps and the decisions still needed. Nothing is sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of agency work for marketing and advertising, an illustrative example of work: preparing a response to a missed milestone, written up here as a self-contained capability template.
